decision_status.current_implementation: SQLite schema v2: patients -> medical_records -> documents; no physical record folders
decision_status.scope: SQLite is the only authoritative store. Directory naming remains a future export/storage reference, not parallel persistence.
decision_status.index_invalidation_requirement: Archive mutations atomically update index_jobs.target_revision and mark existing record_abstracts stale. Rebuild from committed document evidence; errors remain visible.

patient_folder.assignment: Unique user-confirmed English name or romanized name. AI must not invent or transliterate it automatically.
patient_folder.identity: Stable p_<32 lowercase hexadecimal UUID> in patient.json; the slug is a readable name, not identity.
patient_folder.collisions: Reject a duplicate slug and request a distinct user-confirmed name.
patient_folder.unassigned_semantics: A collection of independent unresolved records, never an implied single patient. No patient.json for this bucket.

record_folder.date_policy: Use confirmed printed date/precision or explicitly user-supplied date with provenance. Never substitute upload time.
record_folder.department_policy: Any missing/ambiguous/unmapped classification uses unknown0; otherwise one distinct resolved code uses that code, and two or more distinct resolved codes use multi000.
record_folder.grouping: Similar dates/departments do not automatically establish the same visit. Separate record IDs prevent same-day collisions; grouping requires confirmation.
record_folder.rename: Patient/date/department corrections may move or rename the folder; stable identities and source evidence are preserved.

files.original_filename: Preserved as a Unicode metadata value only; never used as a generated path.
files.encoding: UTF-8 for text and JSON; medical source content may retain any language.
files.missing_text: No fabricated empty extraction files when extraction fails; retain raw source and explicit failure state.

filesystem_index_invalidation_reference.protocol: Persist marker before commit; commit record.json revision last; index the committed revision; clear only the exact processed marker version under the record lock.
filesystem_index_invalidation_reference.recovery: Compare filesystem revisions/hashes and catalog versions with indexed state at startup/reconciliation; recreate missing work.
filesystem_index_invalidation_reference.external_intake: Files manually placed in data/inbox use the same import/commit/invalidation flow.
filesystem_index_invalidation_reference.catalog_provenance: Persist department_catalog_version in record metadata and index; catalog remapping requires an explicit revision and reindex marker.

index_invalidation.protocol: Mutation and pending target_revision commit together. Rebuild the committed archive, store based_on_revision, mark exactly that revision current. Startup and completed workflow/manual/profile/move/delete operations refresh pending jobs.
index_invalidation.completeness: Current job means the saved revision was indexed. Abstract status partial means some documents lack complete clinical extraction; never present it as a complete medical summary.

identity_compatibility: Current SQLite IDs remain existing UUID strings to preserve links. Proposed p_/r_/d_ filesystem prefixes are not applied to existing IDs.
